M-CONFIG.NAME: Project configuration
M-CONFIG.purpose: Load, validate and expose mygrace.config.json with safe v1-compatible defaults (ADR-5).

export-DEFAULT_CONFIG.PURPOSE: Defaults reproducing the v1 layout, budgets and runtimes.

type-MyGraceConfig.PURPOSE: Fully resolved configuration (all fields present after load).

type-IndexCaps.PURPOSE: Line caps for graph, plan and verification indexes.

type-SizeBudgets.PURPOSE: Expected [min, max] line ranges for module/phase/verification files.

fn-configPath.PURPOSE: Absolute config path for a project root.

fn-loadConfig.PURPOSE: Read and validate; throws ConfigError listing every problem.

fn-serializeConfig.PURPOSE: Stable JSON used by setup init.

fn-cloneDefault.PURPOSE: Deep copy of the default configuration.

contract.purpose: Load, validate and expose mygrace.config.json with safe v1-compatible defaults (ADR-5).

error.description: Malformed JSON, wrong types, unknown keys or invalid budget pairs.

notes.note-1: All problems are listed at once so agents can fix a config in one pass.
notes.note-2: Defaults keep existing projects working; nothing hardcodes src/ in new code.
notes.note-3: The config is covered by the trust record, so changing testRunner or allowCommands invalidates trust.
